metadata.description: Bee's Design Harness — an HX-first design system for AI-assisted product design. Core pipeline (research→insight→problem→ideation→wireframe→hifi→build) plus role packs.

plugins.name: harness-core
plugins.description: The design harness core: 5 evidence loops, token/Figma gates, guard hooks, project scaffold, qa + researcher agents. Required by all role packs.

plugins.name: role-designer
plugins.description: The Designer role (default agent): design system, accessibility, motion, polish, critique, hand-off.

plugins.name: role-engineer
plugins.description: The Engineer role: implement from Figma, ship polished UI, design systems in code, deploy.

plugins.name: role-pm
plugins.description: The PM role: discovery, validation, user research, spec & prioritize — feeds the harness loops.

plugins.name: role-copywriter
plugins.description: The Copywriter role: UX writing, product copy, voice alignment — the harness Content block.

plugins.name: role-marketer
plugins.description: The Marketer role: SEO, CRO, launch, brand presence — post-ship growth.

plugins.name: role-founder
plugins.description: The Founder role: validate & discover, scope & build, launch & grow.
